title: physical figures (distance, top speed, sprints) on a moving camera: the product chain against truth and against a constant
written: 2026-11-23, before the moving-camera path is wired into main.py and before any simulated window is rendered or scored
owner request: 2026-11-23: 'Oui, adapte la chaine a la camera mobile'; answers: SoccerTrack for measurement only (nothing trained on it), distances / speeds first, show with a coverage rate when partial
why: on a real Veo export (VEO_FOOTAGE.md, 2026-11-23) main.py applies one homography to a panning camera: top speeds 33-39 km/h, 21 sprints in 25 s. Prior results to beat: distance per team did not beat a constant on the fixed panorama (team_distance/decision.json); top speed had no split-half signal on a 640x360 follow-cam
chain under test (main.py --camera movin: detect_track.run with main.py's defaults (yolov8m, imgsz 640, conf 0.25 / 0.08), team assignment, re-identification, camera_motion.estimate_camera_motion + validate_motion + compensate (if the validator refuses, positions stay uncompensated and the run says so), scale = ground_plane.effective_px_per_m (fallback pixel_scale.estimate_px_per_m from player height), pixel_scale.to_metric_coords, stats.physical_stats unchanged (distance, 95th-percentile top speed, sprints >= 1 s above 20 km/h)
simulated camera: SoccerTrack v2 panorama (fixed camera, 4096 x 1080, 25 fps) cropped to 0.35 of its width at 16:9, the crop centre following the truth players' median as gen_crops.py does (2-s rolling median then 1-s mean), scaled to 1920 x 1080, H.264 at 4.4 Mbit/s (the Veo export's rate), 25 fps. The panorama's fisheye calibration is not physical (fy from 520 to 80,778 px across matches), so no perspective virtual camera is rendered

windows (3 min each, frames 15000-19499.not used: M7 128057 / M9 132831 (sealed), M1 117092 (truth boxes do not fit its video)

matching: per frame, a chain player detection takes the truth person whose box centre (mapped into the crop) is nearest, if within 0.75 x that box's height there; a chain track of >= 10 s with a team is scored if >= 60% of its frames take one truth person, against that person over the track's first to last frame
truth figures: the person's GSR pitch positions (25 fps, on a 1.05 x 0.68 m grid) smoothed by a 1-s centred moving average, then stats.physical_stats on them over the same frames: the same definitions on both sides
constants (leave one window out): distance = track duration x the mean truth speed of scored tracks in the other test windows; top speed = the median truth top speed of scored tracks in the other test windows; sprints = the truth sprint rate per tracked minute pooled over the other test windows

decision (on the 6 test windows, pooled.distance per player-track: shown in the PDF if median |chain - truth| / truth <= 0.15 AND the chain's median relative error is below the constant's, pooled and in >= 4 of 6 windows
decision (on the 6 test windows, pooled.top speed per player-track: shown if median |chain - truth| <= 3 km/h AND below the constant's, pooled and in >= 4 of 6 windows
decision (on the 6 test windows, pooled.sprints per tracked minute (pooled): shown if chain / truth is within [0.67, 1.5] AND |log(chain / truth)| is below the constant's
decision (on the 6 test windows, pooled.otherwise: the PDF says the figure is not measurable on a moving camera and prints no number for it

coverage (reported, and printed in the P: production: tracked player-seconds / (22 x duration); here also the truth side: share of truth player-seconds inside scored tracks, and inside the crop at all
reported, not deciding: the same figures from the current path (auto-calibration + one homography) on the same detections; per-window tables; the camera-motion validator's verdict per window; the scale used vs the truth's median px per m
caveats (stated now): the simulated camera only translates (no perspective change, no zoom), which makes compensation easier than on a Veo export; players are smaller than in a Veo export (~43 px panorama boxes x 1.34, vs 60-130 px measured); truth is quantised and smoothed at 1 s, so path lengths compare at that scale; one venue and one camera model; 18 min of test play
